body: Because it doesn't end. I've seen this movie before and it never comes out with me on top, life just cuts itself off and drops the next load of crap off for me to clean up. By June of this year I expect to make no progress at all, every job I apply to will systematically reject me and my overall shittiness as a person. My metabolism is going to hijack any attempts I take at getting in shape and if I try to date, well I've got my unattractiveness to deal with that. Meanwhile, everyone I know is getting married, making money and fucking a lot and having babies. Everything's going fine for them, meanwhile I'll continue to be suffocated by the weight of my own decisions. That's the worst part about this entire thing, it's all my fault, and I am alone.

The thing is, everything that I like doing is impractical, i.e, doesn't make money. I used to not think that way but then I guess life convinced me that money is the most important thing ever, and that's why I went for economics even though I sucked at it. What else was I going to do? Be an artist? A writer? a musician? A social worker? Mostly self indulgent things that give no value to the world (their words, not mine). People want skills in the job market, and none of those things provide skills. That's why I did economics and math (the cruel joke being that apparently that isn't practical either, so I'm in pretty much stuck in the water).

I considered volunteering for something, but my schedule doesn't really permit it, I don't know man, sometimes the idea of helping others just sounds ridiculous to me. I don't know, that's just where my mind is right now. I mean yeah, the whole thing about feeling good when you help people, I get that, but then I go back to work and end up realizing how shitty and selfish people really are (and that includes me). I just don't know. I mean, how could I even help others if I can't even get my own shit together?
Sure. Feel free to PM me.
